config.yaml:
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
      http:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318          # ← NCCL Inspector 推 OTLP metrics 用

  # dynamo 组件原生暴露 Prometheus 格式 /metrics，主动拉取后转 OTLP 再 remote write 出去。
  # 两类 job：
  #   dynamo-frontend  component_type=frontend           -> podIP:8000 (axum HTTP 服务挂 /metrics)
  #   dynamo-worker    component_type∈{worker,prefill,decode} -> podIP:9090 (SGLang --enable-metrics)
  # 都走 pod SD + nvidia.com/* label 过滤，不依赖任何 Service 名（Service 名带 DGD hash，重建即换）。
  # 权限依赖 otel-collector SA 的 list/watch pods（已由 otel-collector-k8sattributes ClusterRole 具备）。
  prometheus:
    config:
      global:
        scrape_interval: 15s
        scrape_timeout: 10s
      scrape_configs:
        # ---- Frontend: HTTP 入口，:8000 /metrics ----
        # 暴露 dynamo_frontend_*、dynamo_component_router_*、dynamo_routing_overhead_*
        - job_name: dynamo-frontend
          kubernetes_sd_configs:
            - role: pod
              namespaces:
                names: [nhi]
          relabel_configs:
            - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_nvidia_com_dynamo_component_type]
              regex: frontend
              action: keep
            - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_ip]
              target_label: __address__
              replacement: $1:8000
            - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_name]
              target_label: pod
            - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_namespace]
              target_label: namespace
            - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app_kubernetes_io_name]
              target_label: dynamo_dgd
            - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_nvidia_com_dynamo_component]
              target_label: dynamo_component
            - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_nvidia_com_dynamo_namespace]
              target_label: dynamo_namespace
            - target_label: dynamo_component_type
              replacement: frontend
            - target_label: cluster
              replacement: ack-LB97i2CZNR

        # ---- Engine: SGLang worker（aggregated / prefill / decode），:9090 /metrics ----
        # 暴露 sglang:* 与 dynamo_component_*（工作端 DRT 侧）
        # 沿用 dynamo-worker 这个 job 名以免下游看板断链；component_type 从 pod label 取，
        # 不再硬 replacement=worker，方便后端按 {worker,prefill,decode} 分组。
        - job_name: dynamo-worker
          kubernetes_sd_configs:
            - role: pod
              namespaces:
                names: [nhi]
          relabel_configs:
            - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_nvidia_com_dynamo_component_type]
              regex: (worker|prefill|decode)
              action: keep
            - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_ip]
              target_label: __address__
              replacement: $1:9090
            - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_name]
              target_label: pod
            - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_namespace]
              target_label: namespace
            - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app_kubernetes_io_name]
              target_label: dynamo_dgd
            - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_nvidia_com_dynamo_component]
              target_label: dynamo_component
            - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_nvidia_com_dynamo_namespace]
              target_label: dynamo_namespace
            - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_nvidia_com_dynamo_component_type]
              target_label: dynamo_component_type
            - target_label: cluster
              replacement: ack-LB97i2CZNR

processors:
  k8sattributes:
    auth_type: serviceAccount
    passthrough: false
    pod_association:
      - sources:
          - from: connection
    extract:
      metadata:
        - k8s.pod.name
        - k8s.namespace.name
        - k8s.node.name
        - k8s.deployment.name
      labels:
        - tag_name: app.name
          key: app
          from: pod
        - tag_name: jobname
          key: dros.zjlab.io/jobname
          from: pod

  # 对齐 maas-dev：补齐 ONE 接入规范要求的 host.name / host.ip
  # （ack-LB 无 higress / smg / sglang，maas-dev 里的 span 级治理规则不适用，故只搬资源级规则）
  # 注意：context: resource 下必须写成 resource.attributes[...]，
  #       旧式 attributes[...] 在 0.120 会被自动改写并告警，更高版本将报错。
  transform:
    error_mode: ignore
    trace_statements:
      - context: resource
        statements:
          - set(resource.attributes["host.name"], resource.attributes["k8s.pod.name"]) where resource.attributes["host.name"] == nil and resource.attributes["k8s.pod.name"] != nil
          - set(resource.attributes["host.name"], resource.attributes["k8s.node.name"]) where resource.attributes["host.name"] == nil and resource.attributes["k8s.node.name"] != nil
          - set(resource.attributes["host.ip"], resource.attributes["k8s.pod.ip"]) where resource.attributes["host.ip"] == nil and resource.attributes["k8s.pod.ip"] != nil

  # 两个集群的 trace 汇入同一目的地后，必须能区分来源
  # 取值与 nhi-vector-agg-traces 写入 clickhouse 的 cluster_id 列一致
  resource:
    attributes:
      - key: cluster
        value: ack-LB97i2CZNR
        action: upsert

  batch:
    timeout: 5s
    send_batch_size: 1024

  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 1s
    limit_mib: 512
    spike_limit_mib: 128

exporters:
  # --- 本地 traces 出口: nhi 自建 clickhouse 链路（保持不动）---
  otlp/vector:
    endpoint: nhi-vector-agg-traces.nhi.svc.cluster.local:4317
    tls:
      insecure: true

  # --- 统一出口 1: kafka（brokers / topic 与 maas-dev 完全一致）---
  kafka:
    brokers:
      - "10.107.159.7:9092"
      - "10.107.159.8:9092"
      - "10.107.159.9:9092"
      - "10.107.159.10:9092"
    protocol_version: "3.0.0"
    timeout: 5s
    topic: llm-trace-dev
    retry_on_failure:
      enabled: true
      initial_interval: 5s
      max_interval: 30s
      max_elapsed_time: 300s
    sending_queue:
      enabled: true
      num_consumers: 10
      queue_size: 1000

  # --- 统一出口 2: 博睿 ONE APM（endpoint / header 与 maas-dev 完全一致）---
  # 2026-10-29 实测: otlphttp sent_spans=32 / send_failed=0，出口正常工作。
  # 环境约束：可达性取决于 Pod 所在节点池。collector 当前在 cn-hangzhou-zjy-d01.10.200.99.5
  # （10.200.99.x 节点组）可达；用 i-d64r... 节点组（10.202.72.x）的 Pod 测会 timed out。
  # 若 collector 被调度到 10.202.72.x 节点，本出口将失败（不影响其他出口）。
  otlphttp:
    endpoint: "http://10.107.205.20:58897/APM/otel"
    compression: gzip
    timeout: 10s
    headers:
      x-br-acid: "d17761f7-6ae0-11f1-b86d-9cc2c4bb289f"

  # --- metrics 出口 1: 博睿 ONE Prometheus 接入点（独立接入 ID，与 trace 的 acid 不同）---
  prometheusremotewrite/one:
    endpoint: "http://10.107.205.20:58897/integration/prometheus/metric/76146db7-faa5-4873-9de5-c013c7dd5b9f"
    timeout: 15s
    resource_to_telemetry_conversion:
      enabled: true                     # 把 job/instance 等 resource 属性还原成 metric label
    retry_on_failure:
      enabled: true
      initial_interval: 5s
      max_interval: 30s
      max_elapsed_time: 300s
    # 注：prometheusremotewrite 在本版本不接受顶层 sending_queue（会报 invalid keys），
    #     需要队列时用 remote_write_queue 子节点。

  # --- metrics 出口 2: nhi 自建 aggr remote-write 入口 ---
  # 注意 endpoint 必须结束于 /：vector 的 prometheus_remote_write source 只接受根路径，
  # 原配的 /api/v1/write 会直接 404（vector 日志确证 Path not found）。
  prometheusremotewrite/prom:
    endpoint: http://nhi-vector-agg-metrics.nhi.svc.cluster.local:6004/
    resource_to_telemetry_conversion:
      enabled: true                     # 将 OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES → metric label

service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [memory_limiter, k8sattributes, transform, resource, batch]
      exporters: [otlp/vector, kafka, otlphttp]
    # --- metrics 管线: 不启用 k8sattributes (避免额外开销) ---
    # 两个来源：otlp（NCCL Inspector 推入）+ prometheus（主动拉 dynamo）
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp, prometheus]
      processors: [memory_limiter, batch]
      exporters: [prometheusremotewrite/one, prometheusremotewrite/prom]
  telemetry:
    logs:
      level: info
